title: Astrologer

inlines.v: ASTROL'OGER, ASTROLO'GIAN, noun [Latin astrologus, of a star, and discourse.] 1. One who professes to foretell future events by the aspects and situation of the stars. Astrologian is little used. 2. Formerly, one who understood the motions of the planets, without predicting.
